info.title: TaskForce API
info.description: REST API of TaskForce, the open-source project management and AI delivery platform

servers.description: The hosted TaskForce, the API of the web app at https://app.taskforce-project.fr.
A self-hosted instance with the default settings: use the instance's TF_API_URL from its .env.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Sign-up, sign-in, verification codes and sessions.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces: creation, members and settings.

tags.name: Workspace files
tags.description: A whole workspace as one file, its Brain OS and all its projects: download it, or create a new workspace from it.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Projects, their visibility, statuses and issue types.

tags.name: Project files
tags.description: A whole project as one file: download it, or create a project from it.

tags.name: Issues
tags.description: Issues: status, priority, relations, subtasks and comments.

tags.name: Cycles
tags.description: Cycles: time-boxed iterations and their progress.

tags.name: Roadmap
tags.description: Work planned over time.

tags.name: Personal access tokens
tags.description: Personal access tokens, valid on the MCP server only.

tags.name: Passkeys
tags.description: The person's passkeys: add one, list them, remove one. Signing in with a passkey is under Authentication.

tags.name: Desktop sessions
tags.description: The desktop app's sessions of the person: approve a sign-in from the web app, list the computers, sign one out.

tags.name: Assignments
tags.description: Accepting and declining issue assignments.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: In-app notifications (Signals) and their state.

tags.name: AI assistant
tags.description: Cortex: conversations and AI help.

tags.name: Test bank
tags.description: Test cases drawn from Cortex answers, replayed on a named model without touching the workspace, and graded by code.

tags.name: Model capabilities
tags.description: What each model the instance's AI reaches can do, measured by fixed test cases: the table, a measure case by case, and the model the person chooses for Cortex.

tags.name: Model benchmark
tags.description: What can be given to each model: seven tasks from real work, graded by code, a verdict per model and task that a person can overturn, and a blind trial on one of their issues.

tags.name: AI analysis (workflows)
tags.description: AI analysis jobs: launch, follow and resume.

tags.name: Brain OS
tags.description: The workspace's knowledge base: Markdown pages, links, tags, search and ingestion.

tags.name: Coding agents
tags.description: Delegating an issue to a coding agent (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), or an issue without repository to the trial agent that answers in a comment, and following the run.

tags.name: Coding agent runners
tags.description: Each person's local runner identity, created once, its secret shown once.

tags.name: MCP server
tags.description: The workspace's MCP server (JSON-RPC over HTTP), for Claude Code with a personal access token.

tags.name: Rules
tags.description: The company's rules in layers above TaskForce's floor: read them, write one in words and check its cases, add or remove it, and see what the rules would decide for an action.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Indicators: throughput, velocity, workload and burndown.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Connecting external tools: GitHub, Slack, Plane and MCP servers.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Signed outgoing webhooks (HMAC-SHA256): events, test and delivery history.
